Research opportunities

Research intern recruitment

Work on AI for medical science.

I host research interns working on genomic foundation models, DNA/RNA sequence design, and recursively self-improving AI agents. GPU resources are available for research experiments.

Research areas

Genomic foundation models

Pretraining and adapting models for genomic representation learning and biological applications.

Scientific sequence design

Guided generation and optimization of DNA/RNA sequences.

AI agents and model infrastructure

Connecting AI agents with tools for training, evaluating, and deploying genomic models.

How to apply

Email your CV and a short summary of your research experience and interests to wwm@u.northwestern.edu.
